Before you buy

What could be hiding behind the paint?

We help you identify the problems that could cost you the most — before you buy.

A property can look perfect on the surface while hiding defects that could cost tens or even hundreds of thousands of dollars to rectify.

Our engineer-led inspections focus on the issues that matter most — structural integrity, water, foundations, drainage and other problems that can significantly affect the safety, value and cost of a property.

Unapproved or poorly executed alterations

Extensions, renovations, converted spaces and structural modifications that may lack appropriate approvals, engineering or compliant construction.

Potential rectification$20,000–$100,000+

The problems that can really hurt your budget

Page 2 of 4

Structural defects

Removed load-bearing walls, inadequate beams or columns, major cracking, movement or poorly executed structural alterations.

Potential rectification>$50,000

Foundation & ground movement

Settlement, subsidence, reactive soils, footing failures and significant differential movement.

Potential rectification>$50,000

Sloping sites & retaining walls

Inadequate retaining structures, unstable slopes, poor drainage or ground movement. In severe cases, rectification may be uneconomical and require demolition and reconstruction.

The problems that can really hurt your budget

Page 3 of 4

Water ingress & waterproofing

Roof leaks, failed balconies, bathroom waterproofing, rising damp, moisture damage and persistent water penetration.

Potential rectification$10,000–$50,000+

Drainage & stormwater

Poor site drainage, water ponding, inadequate falls, damaged stormwater pipes or water being directed toward the building.

Potential rectification$10,000–$30,000+

The problems that can really hurt your budget

Page 4 of 4

Termite & timber damage

Termite activity or significant deterioration of structural timber requiring substantial repair or replacement.

Potential rectification$10,000–$50,000+

Trees & root damage

Trees too close to foundations, retaining walls or underground services, potentially causing structural movement or damage to stormwater infrastructure.

Potential rectification$10,000–$50,000+

One inspection could save you from a very expensive mistake.
